stories.title: Jensen Huang 向 NVIDIA 员工否认“特朗普帮他重返公司”说法
stories.sourceTitle: Jensen Huang reportedly tells Nvidia staff it’s ‘not true’ Trump got him rehired
stories.summary: 报道称，Jensen Huang 在回归后首次全员会上向员工道歉，并试图与白宫和科技领袖帮助他复职的说法保持距离。领导层回归与政治因素纠缠，可能持续影响 NVIDIA 的治理和公众信任。
stories.analysis: 如果回归叙事难以与政治干预切割，NVIDIA 面临的将不只是舆论问题，而是治理可信度问题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to staff during his first all-hands since returning to the company, while attempting to distance himself from the narrative that the White House and tech leaders helped him get his job back, according to reports from Bloomber

stories.title: David Fincher 新片《The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth》因疑似使用生成式 AI 引发争议
stories.sourceTitle: David Fincher is being dragged for suspected use of AI in his latest film
stories.summary: 这部由 Brad Pitt 主演的《Once Upon a Time in Hollywood》续集在早期放映后，引发观众质疑片中是否使用了生成式 AI。好莱坞对 AI 使用的透明度和创作者信任正受到审视。
stories.analysis: 制片方若不说明 AI 使用边界，观众质疑可能先于作品口碑发酵。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Though David Fincher's fans had been eagerly anticipating The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, early screenings of the Once Upon a Time in Hollywood sequel starring Brad Pitt have raised questions about whether generative AI was used in the film. People

stories.title: Tidal 将于 12 月 9 日起封禁 AI 生成音乐，删除约 2900 万首曲目
stories.sourceTitle: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month
stories.summary: Tidal 音乐负责人 Robert Andersen 称，平台将删除约 2900 万首 AI 生成歌曲，并预计每天拒绝 8 万至 8.5 万首上架曲目。这是流媒体平台对 AI slop 泛滥的明确反制。
stories.analysis: 大规模清理能换取曲库质量，但如何区分 AI 辅助与完全生成仍是执行难点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tidal is officially banning AI-generated music on December 9th. As a result of this change, Tidal will delete around 29 million AI-generated songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, according to Tidal music lead Robert Andersen. The move

stories.title: Jensen Huang 深伪视频在 Instagram 走红，成新一轮 AI 垃圾内容
stories.sourceTitle: Jensen Huang deepfakes are the hot new AI slop
stories.summary: 一段观看量近 600 万的 Instagram 视频把 NVIDIA 前 CEO Jensen Huang 合成到 Ibiza 夜店场景中，手持香槟跳舞。名人深伪正从恶搞演变为规模化 AI slop。
stories.analysis: 高辨识度高管形象被滥用，会放大深伪对品牌和公众认知的侵蚀。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Jensen Huang is partying it up in Ibiza. In a video with nearly 6 million views on Instagram, the former CEO of Nvidia is dancing in a crowded club, champagne glass in hand, still wearing his signature black leather jacket. Suddenly, from behind him, Alice Hua

stories.title: 耶鲁 Sonnenfeld：Jensen Huang 在白宫支持下的回归可能让 NVIDIA 董事面临“历史性”责任
stories.sourceTitle: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
stories.summary: Jeffrey Sonnenfeld 警告，市场欢呼的 Huang 以 CEO 和董事身份回归，可能使董事因不断增加的诉讼而承担个人责任。事件把公司治理与政治干预风险推到台前。
stories.analysis: 若回归程序被诉讼挑战，NVIDIA 面临的不只是舆论，而是董事会法律责任。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits

stories.title: 《纽约时报》要求自由摄影师不要升级 Adobe Photoshop 2027，担忧 AI 功能不透明
stories.sourceTitle: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features
stories.summary: 《纽约时报》在邮件中要求自由摄影师避免使用 2027 版 Photoshop，称其 AI 功能的使用方式可能对用户不透明。新闻机构开始把 AI 透明度要求前移到工具链。
stories.analysis: 媒体对 AI 的审慎正从稿件延伸到修图软件，供应商需要提供可审计的使用说明。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The New York Times is asking freelance photographers not to use the newest version of Adobe Photoshop because features in the 2027 update use AI "in ways that may not be apparent to users." In an email seen by The Verge and posted on Threads, two of the Times'

stories.title: Jensen Huang 仍认为继任计划会制造不必要的层级
stories.sourceTitle: Jensen Huang still thinks a succession plan creates unnecessary hierarchy
stories.summary: 在 NVIDIA 刚经历两周“没有创始人会怎样”的考验后，Huang 仍反对设立继任计划，认为它会带来不必要的层级。公司治理与创始人依赖问题再次凸显。
stories.analysis: 创始人中心制在危机后仍不调整，会让投资者更难评估 NVIDIA 的长期接班风险。
stories.sourceExcerpt: It's a remarkable stance for a company that spent the last two weeks finding out what happens without its founder.

stories.title: Jensen Huang 全员会感谢白宫并称正在接受心理治疗
stories.sourceTitle: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
stories.summary: NVIDIA 创始人 Huang 周二向员工道歉，表示感激获得第二次领导公司的机会，并感谢白宫；他还提到自己正在接受治疗。回归后的个人状态与政治关系成为关注点。
stories.analysis: 高管公开谈心理治疗有助于去污名化，但也会让治理争议更受聚焦。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The Nvidia founder apologized to his staff on Tuesday and said he was grateful for a second chance to lead the company.

stories.title: 新基准显示：最强 AI 智能体也难以可靠完成日常任务
stories.sourceTitle: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
stories.summary: 随着个人 AI 助手普及，一项新基准发现，即使最先进模型在完成日常任务时也难以兼顾可靠与安全，还可能引入新问题。个人智能体的能力边界被具体量化。
stories.analysis: 日常任务看似简单，却比演示场景更考验智能体的安全性和容错。
stories.sourceExcerpt: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.

stories.title: Walmart 联手 Meta，让顾客通过 AI 智能体 Muse 购买黑五优惠
stories.sourceTitle: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
stories.summary: Walmart 现在允许顾客通过 Meta 的 AI 智能体 Muse 浏览和购买 Black Friday 优惠。对话式购物开始接入大型零售促销场景。
stories.analysis: 若 AI 智能体能闭环交易，零售流量入口可能从搜索和 App 转向对话代理。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta’s AI agent.

stories.title: Maple 融资 530 万美元，用加密 AI 架构让公司自己也无法访问用户数据
stories.sourceTitle: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
stories.summary: 这家初创公司完成 530 万美元融资，其加密 AI 架构旨在阻止包括 Maple 自身在内的任何一方访问用户私密数据。隐私增强 AI 产品成为融资方向。
stories.analysis: “连自己都看不到”是强隐私承诺，但商业可行性和模型效用仍需验证。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The startup's encrypted AI architecture is designed to prevent even the company itself from accessing users' private data.

stories.title: 英国网络安全机构警告：AI 驱动的攻击正暴露多年薄弱安全基础
stories.sourceTitle: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
stories.summary: 英国网络安全机构称，AI 黑客工具主要利用简单安全漏洞，因此“打好基础”比以往更重要。AI 正在放大既有安全债务。
stories.analysis: 防御重点不应只追 AI 攻击，而是先补齐基础补丁和身份管理。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The British cyber agency says that "building strong foundations has never mattered more" as AI hacking tools rely on exploiting simple security flaws.

stories.title: Anthropic 股价跌破 IPO 发行价，AI 初创估值承压
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
stories.summary: Anthropic 上市后股价跌破发行价，这一低迷表现可能给其他 AI 初创公司的估值带来压力。公开市场开始重新定价 AI 公司。
stories.analysis: 一级市场高估值需要二级市场验证，Anthropic 的走势会成为同类公司的估值锚。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic’s post-IPO slump could put pressure on AI startup valuations.

stories.title: Google Gemini 与 Golden State 合作，为勇士、女武神和 Chase Center 提供球迷体验与运营支持
stories.sourceTitle: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
stories.summary: Google Gemini 与 Golden State 达成合作，将为 Warriors、Valkyries 和 Chase Center 的球迷体验及业务运营提供支持。AI 模型正进入体育场馆和球队运营。
stories.analysis: 体育场景能提供高频互动和运营数据，是 Gemini 企业落地的实用试验场。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google Gemini partners with Golden State to power fan experiences and business operations for the Warriors, Valkyries, and Chase Center. See the news.

stories.title: Meta 把 AI 助手 Muse 直接接入 Instagram 私信
stories.sourceTitle: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
stories.summary: Meta 将 Muse AI 助手集成进 Instagram DMs，用户无需在 Instagram 和 Muse 应用之间切换即可与智能体互动。社交平台正把 AI 助手推到用户沟通入口。
stories.analysis: 私信是高频场景，Muse 入内能提升使用率，但也加大 Meta 对对话数据的掌控。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The new integration gets rid of the need for users to toggle between Instagram and the Muse app when they want to interact with the AI agent.

stories.title: Tidal 将封禁并下架数百万首 AI 生成曲目，称 AI slop 淹没流媒体
stories.sourceTitle: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
stories.summary: Tidal 表示仍将接受 AI 辅助创作的歌曲，但禁止完全由 AI 生成的曲目，以应对 AI slop 淹没音乐流媒体。平台规则从“是否用 AI”转向“AI 参与程度”。
stories.analysis: 完全生成与辅助创作的界线需要可执行检测和申诉机制，否则容易误伤。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.

stories.title: Crusoe 投资人押注太阳能和电池，为未来 AI 数据中心供电
stories.sourceTitle: Why a Crusoe investor is betting on solar and batteries to power future AI data centers
stories.summary: 一位 Crusoe 投资人认为，下一代数据中心每年将需要数十吉瓦电力，太阳能和储能是显然选择。AI 算力扩张正把能源基础设施推到前台。
stories.analysis: 电力获取将和数据中心选址、资本开支同等重要，太阳能加储能或成标配组合。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Next-generation data centers will need tens of gigawatts of power every year. One of Crusoe's investors thinks solar and energy storage are the obvious choice.

stories.title: Pinterest 允许家长限制青少年看到的 AI 生成内容
stories.sourceTitle: Pinterest will now let parents limit the AI-generated content their teens see
stories.summary: 当其他平台聚焦限制青少年使用 AI 聊天机器人时，Pinterest 针对信息流中的 AI 生成内容推出家长限制功能。青少年保护开始覆盖推荐流内容。
stories.analysis: 只管控聊天机器人不够，推荐系统里的 AI 内容同样影响青少年体验。
stories.sourceExcerpt: While other social platforms have focused on restricting teens' access to AI chatbots, Pinterest is addressing the AI content filling their feeds.

stories.title: Amazon 以约 75 亿美元收购 Decart，用软件缩小与 NVIDIA 的芯片差距
stories.sourceTitle: Amazon’s Decart acquisition is a bet on using software to narrow the silicon gap with Nvidia
stories.summary: 据报道，Amazon 以 75 亿美元收购 Decart，旨在提升其 Trainium 芯片的效率。这是云巨头用软件和编译优化弥补硬件差距的尝试。
stories.analysis: 如果软件能提升 Trainium 效率，Amazon 可降低对 NVIDIA 的依赖，但整合效果决定这笔交易价值。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Amazon’s decision to acquire Decart for a reported $7.5 billion is part of its efforts to improve the efficiency of its Trainium chips.

stories.title: OpenAI 称 GPT-6 模型展示内在蛋白质设计能力
stories.sourceTitle: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
stories.summary: OpenAI 表示，GPT-6 模型可利用推理和代码设计蛋白质结构与序列，实验室测试在五个靶点上发现结合证据。通用模型正进入生物设计领域。
stories.analysis: 若结果可复现，GPT-6 可能把蛋白质设计从专用模型扩展到通用推理模型。
stories.sourceExcerpt: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.

stories.title: 两位业余天文学家借助 OpenAI Codex 和 Astra 从 NASA 公开数据中寻找潜在系外行星
stories.sourceTitle: Searching for distant planets with Astra
stories.summary: OpenAI 介绍两位业余天文学家使用 Codex 和 Astra，在 NASA Kepler 与 TESS 望远镜的公开数据中寻找潜在系外行星。AI 工具正在降低天文数据分析门槛。
stories.analysis: 公开数据加 AI 代理让非专业研究者也能参与发现，但候选行星仍需专业验证。
stories.sourceExcerpt: See how two amateur astronomers used Codex and Astra to find potential exoplanets in public data from NASA’s Kepler and TESS space telescopes.

stories.title: The Verge 评论：Jensen Huang 回归凸显“精英免责”
stories.sourceTitle: Welcome to elite impunity, Jensen Huang
stories.summary: The Verge 评论文章批评 Huang 再次出任 NVIDIA CEO，称除特朗普和万斯外几乎所有人都感到意外，并将此事描述为精英免责。舆论聚焦政治关系与问责。
stories.analysis: 这是观点文章，但反映外界对科技领袖问责标准不一致的不满。
stories.sourceExcerpt: I suppose I must issue a hearty congratulations to Jensen Huang. Huang is CEO of Nvidia again, to the surprise of basically everyone except President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance, who made sure it happened. Now, those of us who had some kind of bas

stories.title: AI 数据中心给混乱的联合国气候谈判再添难题
stories.sourceTitle: AI data centers throw another wrench into chaotic UN climate talks
stories.summary: 在 COP31 气候大会上，代表们不得不应对一个矛盾：全球经济电气化需要清洁能源，而高耗能 AI 数据中心正推高电力需求。AI 的能源账单进入气候议程。
stories.analysis: AI 扩张若不能同步匹配清洁电力，会成为气候谈判和能源规划的新摩擦点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The clean energy revolution hinges on electrifying the entire global economy just as power-hungry data centers are surging. It's a challenge delegates from all over the world had to grapple with during the United Nations climate conference, called COP31, that

stories.title: Intentful 用 OpenAI 的 dots 让 AI 助手 Aria 研究网站并生成提案
stories.sourceTitle: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
stories.summary: Marina Petrova 的 dot Aria 可帮助研究网站、构建提案，并主动标记消息和解决问题。OpenAI 案例展示 AI 助手如何承担业务流程中的主动任务。
stories.analysis: 从被动问答到主动处理消息，AI 助手的价值取决于能否可靠接管跨应用工作流。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Marina Petrova’s dot Aria helps research websites and build proposals, while proactively flagging messages and resolving issues.

stories.title: OpenAI 与 Cisco 推出开源 Linux 运行时 Shirudo，帮助打补丁期间保护运行系统
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
stories.summary: OpenAI 和 Cisco 发布开源 Linux 运行时 Shirudo，旨在帮助团队在部署补丁期间保护正在运行的系统。AI 公司与网络设备商合作进入系统安全运行时。
stories.analysis: 补丁窗口是攻击高发期，Shirudo 若易集成可成为运维安全的基础组件。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

stories.title: 谷歌开源环境质量智能体 AQuA，用于诊断生产环境 AI 智能体故障
stories.sourceTitle: 谷歌开源环境质量智能体 AQuA，用于诊断生产环境 AI 智能体故障
stories.summary: 谷歌开源 AQuA，一个面向生产环境的智能体，用于诊断 AI 智能体运行故障。它值得关注，因为生产级可观测性正成为智能体落地的瓶颈。
stories.analysis: 智能体故障诊断从人工日志转向专用智能体，有望降低运维成本。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: Qwen 发布 Qwen3Guard，为 token 流提供实时安全防护
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen 家族推出首个安全护栏模型 Qwen3Guard，基于 Qwen3 微调用于安全分类，可对 token 流进行实时防护。模型安全从输出审核前移到生成过程。
stories.analysis: 实时 token 级防护适合高交互应用，但分类延迟和误判率决定可用性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tech Report GitHub Hugging Face ModelScope DISCORD Introduction We are excited to introduce Qwen3Guard, the first safety guardrail model in the Qwen family. Built upon the powerful Qwen3 foundation models and fine-tuned specifically for safety classificatoin,

stories.title: 业界首提“端侧超节点”，让端侧 AI 组队计算：AI 效率暴涨 270%，不用换芯片或模型
stories.sourceTitle: 业界首提“端侧超节点”，让端侧AI组队计算：AI效率暴涨270%，不用换芯片或模型
stories.summary: 量子位报道，辛米尔提出“端侧超节点”，让端侧 AI 组队计算，称 AI 效率提升 270%，且无需更换芯片或模型。端侧算力协作成为物理 AI 规模化落地的新思路。
stories.analysis: 若效率提升可复现，端侧协同可绕过硬件升级，但实际组网和调度复杂度是关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 端侧老炮辛米尔，打通物理AI规模化落地之路
